タクティクスオウガ
質量／物語
ヴァレリア島を舞台に繰り広げられる戦記物語。物語の舞台は島１つと狭いが、細かい設定と深い物語の数々が、逆に世界の広さを感じさせる。
blocks.translation: This is a war chronicle set on the island of Valeria. Although the story takes place on just one small island, its detailed setting and many deep narratives give a sense of how expansive the world really is.

blocks.source: 全４章で構成されているが、選択肢によって２章は２通り、３章は３通りに分岐するので質量満点である。特に２章への分岐に関わる選択肢は非常に印象が強い。（残念ながら最終章である４章の内容はどのルートでも、大きく変化しない。）
blocks.translation: The game consists of four chapters, but Chapter 2 branches into two paths and Chapter 3 into three, depending on your choices, making it rich in content. The choices that affect the branch into Chapter 2 are especially memorable. (Unfortunately, the content of the final Chapter 4 does not change significantly between routes.)

blocks.source: システム／バランス
高低差を取り入れた戦闘システムが特徴。豊富な職業や魔法、アイテムが存在し、プレイヤーによって、様々な遊び方がある。装備を外して、キャラクターを素早くするなど、戦術の自由度も素晴らしく高い。
blocks.translation: Its battle system, which incorporates differences in elevation, is a defining feature. With a wealth of classes, spells, and items, it offers many different ways to play depending on the player. The tactical freedom is also remarkably high, allowing you to do things like remove equipment to make characters faster.

blocks.source: システム上、剣などの近接武器よりも弓が強いが、これはこれで弓ゲーとして受け入れたほうが良いのかも知れない。実際、高低差があるマップにて、位置取りを考えながら、弓で戦うだけでも、それなりに高い戦略性がある。
blocks.translation: Although bows are stronger than melee weapons such as swords in terms of the game system, perhaps it is best to accept this as a bow-focused game. In fact, even simply fighting with bows while considering positioning on maps with elevation differences offers a fairly high level of strategic depth.

blocks.source: 事前知識を持たず普通にプレイすると、非常に手ごたえがあるが、トレーニングでレベル上げができるため、ライトユーザも十分クリア可能だ。
blocks.translation: Playing normally without any prior knowledge is very challenging, but since you can level up through training, even casual players can clear the game.

blocks.source: 前述した通り、魔法やアイテムの種類は非常に豊富で、中には普通のRPGでは、まず採用しないような、とんでも無い効果を持った物がある。一部を紹介すると以下の通り。
blocks.translation: As mentioned above, there is an extremely wide variety of spells and items, including some with outrageous effects that would never normally be included in a typical RPG. Here are a few examples:

blocks.source: 死亡した仲間をアンデッドとして復活させる魔法。
blocks.translation: A spell that revives a fallen ally as an undead.

blocks.source: アンデッドを人間に転生させる魔法。能力をそのままにレベルが１になる。
blocks.translation: A spell that reincarnates an undead creature as a human. Its level becomes 1 while retaining its abilities.

blocks.source: 術者を剣に変化させる魔法。剣は威力は異常に強力だが、元の人間には戻れない。
blocks.translation: A spell that transforms the caster into a sword. The sword is extraordinarily powerful, but the caster can never return to human form.

blocks.source: 敵と自分の体を入れ替える効果を持った剣。要するにギニューのボディチェンジ。
blocks.translation: A sword that swaps your body with that of an enemy. In other words, Ginyu's Body Change.

blocks.source: これらをプレイヤー側が使えるというのだから驚きである。ただし、インパクトがある分、下３つは非常に強力でゲームバランスを崩壊させる。その代わり、入手は難しく終盤のサブイベントで『死者の宮殿』の奥まで潜る必要があるという様には調整されている。ちなみに、このダンジョン「地下１００階建て」「セーブは不可」「脱出は自由だが１階からやり直し」という厳しい仕様になっている。
blocks.translation: It is astonishing that the player can use these abilities. However, because of their impact, the last three are extremely powerful and destroy the game's balance. In exchange, they are difficult to obtain: they are designed so that, during a late-game side event, you must descend deep into the Palace of the Dead. Incidentally, this dungeon has some harsh specifications: it is 100 floors underground, saving is not allowed, and although you can leave freely, you must start over from the first floor.

blocks.source: なお、死者の宮殿程では無いにせよ、ラストダンジョンもセーブができないままの連戦なので、かなり難しい。個人的には、死者の宮殿を深入りせず、浅い階（４～２５階程度）で装備を強化してから、ラストに挑むと、丁度良いかと思う。
blocks.translation: Although it is not quite as demanding as the Palace of the Dead, the final dungeon is also quite difficult because it consists of consecutive battles without being able to save. Personally, I think it is best to avoid going too deep into the Palace of the Dead, strengthen your equipment on the upper floors (around Floors 4 to 25), and then challenge the final dungeon.

blocks.source: 快適性
SRPGの宿命だが、１戦闘は長めで、難易度もやや高いため、ファイアーエムブレムほどでは無いが、プレイしていて疲れる。魔法の演出も後半は特に時間が掛かるものがある。また、トレーニングによるレベル上げは面倒かもしれない。
blocks.translation: This is an unavoidable trait of SRPGs, but battles are fairly long and the difficulty is somewhat high, so playing can be tiring, though not as much as Fire Emblem. Some spell effects, especially in the latter half, also take a long time to play out. Leveling up through training may be tedious as well.

blocks.source: 美術
グラフィックは斜め視点で描かれる。演出・ドット絵と共にSFCでは最高レベルで、キャラクターのアニメーションはとても細かい。特にオープニングの作りこみは、今見ても驚かされる。軍隊に襲われ炎上する町の様子など、イベントシーンのクオリティは半端ない。
blocks.translation: The graphics are presented from an isometric perspective. Along with its presentation and pixel art, they are of the highest quality on the SFC, and the character animations are incredibly detailed. The care put into the opening in particular is still astonishing to watch today. The quality of event scenes, such as the depiction of a town being attacked and set ablaze by an army, is extraordinary.

blocks.source: 音楽
作曲者は崎元仁氏と岩田匡治氏の２名。曲調は壮大で展開は大きく、ドラマチックなシーンが多い本作を盛り上げる。特にエンディング曲は全てのRPGの中でのベストエンディング曲だと思っている。
blocks.translation: The music was composed by Hitoshi Sakimoto and Masaharu Iwata. The sweeping melodies and grand developments enhance this game, which features many dramatic scenes. In particular, I consider its ending theme the best ending song in any RPG.

blocks.source: まとめ
やや、ヘビーユーザー向けだが、ライトユーザーでもどうにかできる間口の広さもある。SFC最高傑作というか、未だにゲーム史上最高傑作として良く挙げられるタイトルである。
blocks.translation: Although it is somewhat geared toward hardcore players, it is also accessible enough for casual players to manage. It is often cited not only as the SFC's greatest masterpiece, but still as one of the greatest games in video game history.
